listing.name: Dragon Ball GT: Final Bout — DragonBallGTFinalBoutRecomp (mstan) (mstan)
listing.summary: Build Dragon Ball GT: Final Bout locally from your USA disc. Upstream advertises gameplay, network play and adaptive widescreen; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS00493 disc. The optional FuniDub feature also needs your own USA PlayStation 2 Budokai Tenkaichi 3 ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream setup with the v1.0.0 ZIP, which includes OpenBIOS and tools. Compile the game locally from your own disc.

warnings: Upstream advertises gameplay, network play and adaptive widescreen. Portcove has not tested those features.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
